*n/m = not meaningful. This is the first fully clean 7-day window since the 8-day poll gap, but the comparison week (07-20→07-26) is still majority inside that gap's tail — only 4 of its 7 days (07-23→07-26) have actionable data; 07-20/21/22 are dark. A raw delta against a mostly-dark baseline would overstate this week's real change. 08-03→08-10 vs this window will be the first genuinely clean WoW comparison.

*New this week:* 2 KB entries opened, both `ms-tables-fields-api`, both scored below the DM escalation threshold so never posted — sitting only in the suppressed pile:
• `ki-2026-07-28-tables-fields-editview-viewgen-failed-after-retry` — ViewService.EditView "Failed to generate view" after its single retry fails
• `ki-2026-07-31-tables-fields-findviewfailed-getfieldnameswithrestriction` — "Find View Failed", no exception captured
Both fire under the same noisy bare monitor (299251404/299251464) family that has now produced 7+ distinct undocumented bug signatures without ever being split by exception type.

*Aging:* 7 entries with fix_status apparently unchanged ≥30d (proxy: first_seen — the KB schema doesn't track a separate status-change timestamp, so true unchanged-duration may be shorter) — oldest: `ki-2026-07-03-method-ui-grid-dropdown-performance-test-nodata`, still `confirmed-non-prod-noise`, ~93d. Also aging: `ki-2026-07-03-warehouse-dashboard-network-test-nodata` (~88d), `ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring` (~72d, still just `investigating`), `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout` (~59d since its last real status change to `chronic-residual-post-rollback-2026-06-05` — this one has a genuine change-date, not a proxy — 614 occurrences all-time, the KB's largest entry), `ki-2026-07-03-eda-consumer-amqp-stopped-publishing` (~44d, `escalated-for-review`), `ki-2026-07-04-ms-account-api-4xx-spike-monitor-noise` (~31d), `ki-2026-07-04-crm-amqp-consumer-monitor-family-quiet-period-flap` (~30d).

*Concentration:* top 3 of this week's suppressed-pile recurrences (`ki-...grid-dropdown`, `ki-...gateway-microservices-timeout`, `ki-...crm-amqp...flap` — tied with `ki-...notifications-p95...` at 9) = 57 of 92 occurrences (62%) — in line with Method's standing ~66% all-time top-3 figure, slightly less concentrated this week.

*Suppression ratio:* known-issue-recurrence — ~82/152 (54%) suppressed inside the 24h window or a same-cycle gate-ordering artifact, ~70 posted (window-expiry or 10th-occurrence resurface; all logged as `message_type=known-issue` — no `known-issue-recurrence` spelling appeared this window). needs-human — ~21/35 (60%) held to actionable.md (daily-cap-deferred or below the escalation threshold), 14 posted.

One thing worth doing next week: `ki-2026-07-03-method-ui-grid-dropdown-performance-test-nodata` has sat at `confirmed-non-prod-noise` for 93 days at 154 occurrences without ever being muted or given a longer eval interval — it's now the single largest recurring item in the digest two weeks running.
